narrative.details:
You open the aged and weathered envelope and discover an official looking document. You recognize the seal of Admiral Proudmoore.

This looks important. Perhaps Gar'Thok, the commander of Razor Hill, would be interested in having this information.
narrative.objectives: Take Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.
narrative.offerRewardText: This does not bode well at all. You were wise to bring this information to my attention.
narrative.requestItemsText: There is a look of concern on your face, Champion. What have you there?
